import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

TAG = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

for row in root.iter(TAG + 'row'):
    for c in row.findall(TAG + 'c'):
        f = c.find(TAG + 'f')
        v = c.find(TAG + 'v')
        if f is not None:
            print(c.get('r'), 'formula:', f.text, '| cached:', v.text if v is not None else None)
